questions.q: How many euros will the first person who stops and helps get?
questions.e: In the video: "Prva osoba koja stane i pomogne mi da zamenim gumu dobija 200 evra" — the first person who stops and helps change the tyre gets 200 euros.

questions.q: What does Luka ask the driver who stopped?
o: How to get to the centre
questions.e: In the video: "Je li imate možda ovu dizalicu" — do you happen to have this jack?

questions.q: What happened with the first driver who stopped?
o: He helped and took the money
He stopped but could not help
questions.e: In the video: "ali nažalost nije mogao da mi pomogne" — but unfortunately he could not help me.

questions.q: What does Luka offer the driver as thanks?
questions.e: In the video: "Hajde da vas počastim" — let me treat you.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Prva osoba koja stane i pomogne mi da zamenim *gumu*
questions.e: Guma — rubber, tyre; gumu — acc. case.

questions.q: ali *nažalost* nije mogao da mi pomogne
Ali ovo je *zahvalnost* za tu pomoć.

questions.e: After words of quantity (dosta) the genitive is needed: automobila.

questions.q: I kad dođem na ručak kod vas u ___
questions.e: Movement "where to?" — the preposition u + accusative: u restoran.
The preposition u answering "where?" takes the locative: u restoranu.
The set phrase "nema na čemu" ("you're welcome") uses the locative.
